Data:U.numa.skill.1.json.comments: The readable tag locks out book reading, currently the only other way to see this recipe with this combo - but this isn't wildly stable and will probably resurface.
Data:U.numa.skill.1.json.startdescription: This mist will pass. What will pass with it? [You can choose to forget everything you know of this Skill - since you haven't yet committed it to the Tree of Wisdoms. You'll gain a Many-Faceted Lesson, which can be used to upgrade any other skill, but which always disappears at dawn - and which cannot be used to regain your lost skill.]

Data:U.numa.skill.2to1.json.startdescription: That brightness in the mist - is it the Sun? It might be unwise to gaze into it. [You can choose to forget almost everything you have learnt of this Skill, reducing it to level 1 - since you haven't yet committed it to the Tree of Wisdoms. You'll gain 1 Many-Faceted Lesson, one fewer than you spent to get this far... for though much abides, something is always taken. Many-Faceted Lessons can be used to upgrade any Skill, but always disappear at dawn.]
Data:U.numa.skill.2to1.json.desc: [This skill is now level 1. Use your Many-Faceted Lessons wisely.]

Data:U.numa.skill.hint.committed.json.label: In Numa...
Data:U.numa.skill.hint.committed.json.startdescription: In this season, memory can sometimes be a mirror; but not all mirrors may be broken. [Had this Skill not yet been committed to the Tree, Numa would have offered you an unusual action.]

Data:U.numa.skill.hint.json.label: In Numa...
Data:U.numa.skill.hint.json.startdescription: In this season, memory can sometimes be a mirror; which is to say, among other things, we might consider its shattering. [Add an Element of the Soul to learn about an unusual action only available in Numa.]
